obligation: G023 chain step 1 — a sealed source-body audit for model #2

verified_by.note: verify() returns the verified DOCUMENT, not the seal string; a first reading compared its repr to the hash and reported a false mismatch

how_it_was_run.why_incrementally: the drive reads at 0.9 MiB/s while the lake fill runs, so a contended hash of 57 GiB would have taken 17 hours and starved the user's stated priority
how_it_was_run.method: one bounded pass inside a ProtectedWindow: fill paused, hash, fill resumed

a_measurement_i_got_wrong.predicted: 5.9 MiB/s uncontended, so 163 minutes for 57 GiB
a_measurement_i_got_wrong.actual: 16 shards, 56.9 GiB, inside a single 25-minute window (~38 MiB/s)
a_measurement_i_got_wrong.why: the 512 MiB probe read the first shard's opening region and generalised from it; sustained sequential reads on this drive are several times faster than that sample suggested
a_measurement_i_got_wrong.lesson: a single short probe is not a throughput measurement, which is the same error the concurrency sweep made earlier in this campaign

what_this_unblocks: chain step 2, CompleteBinaryGravity, which requires exactly this sealed audit and its seal as an input
what_it_does_not_do: produce an artifact. The audit records shard hashes; no tensor has been packed.
